verdict: No actionable findings in the bounded local workout-history reader delta. Local verification only; deployment and production acceptance are not granted.

independence.description: Informed independent reviewer/verifier; builder supplied intent and test claims. Reviewer inspected source and tests and independently executed checks, with separate requirement-derived synthetic probes and in-memory transform-only negative controls. No original runtime/tests were modified; disposable probes are archived as text.

acceptanceOracle.source: Parent task requirements, existing public request contract and immutable prior package
checks: Authenticated owner is resolved before reads and cannot be selected by input. Every fetched history owner mismatch fails closed, including the second read.
Seven inclusive local calendar dates for days=7, raw Date.getTimezoneOffset convention, same server capture cutoff for both reads.
Factual projection retains source quantities, literal weights and provenance without numeric policy authority; no raw workout notes/input payload. Unknown logging coverage stays unknown.
Outages, missing counts, caps, unconfirmed prescription work and budget omissions never become complete empty history.
Changed workout or completion result returns retryable409 independently of coach revisions; consistency is application double-read, not an atomic database snapshot.

Both existing cookie and verified MCP surfaces receive factual history with shared planner flag false; SELECT-only capability prevents mutations/RPC. Planning flag, other consumers and accepted programming remain unchanged.

codeAssessment.ownerIsolation: Owner-filtered queries plus pre-projection assertions on both history snapshots; generic503 on mismatched or malformed owners.
codeAssessment.minimization: Default shared reader omits notes/input_text and selects named factual fields; existing factual projector bounds records, keeps provenance/uncertainty and never accepts a new plan.
codeAssessment.failureSemantics: Stable read errors remain unavailable/null with explicit gap; exact-count mismatch or absent count remains incomplete. Different generations return409. No false claim that all exercise was logged.
codeAssessment.concurrency: Raw selected history compared at one capture cutoff. ABA/unobserved post-second-read updates remain possible and are outside the stated double-read guarantee.
codeAssessment.unchangedConsumers: Prior-package hash comparison of shared planner/capability/projection files and focused consumer tests confirms no rollout change to planning behavior.

environment.execution: PowerShell with process-local TEMP/TMP pointing to existing local temp; use_default execution succeeded. No install/escalation/browser/live requests required.

negativeControls.mechanism: Disposable Vite pre-transform configurations remove only specified safeguards in memory; original source and tests retain exact hashes.

strengths: Fixture executes real eq/range/order/cap/projection semantics rather than returning candidate-shaped output. Write/RPC calls throw and are observed.
Existing tests cover both surfaces, raw western midnight window, count caps, record budget, owner failures, post-cutoff creates/amendments, and independent history changes.
Reviewer supplemented supported eastern offset=-720 boundary, missing exact count, and owner violation appearing only in second read.
limits: Synthetic client does not prove deployed Supabase schema/RLS/count behavior or production latency.
Reviewer probes were designed after code inspection, so do not claim independent blind pre-implementation oracle.

Initial disposable-probe run had two reviewer fixture mistakes: unsupported -840 offset and recursive mock wrapper. Corrected to supported -720 and captured mock implementation; initial harness report retained. These were not candidate failures.

localProposalReview.assessment: Accurately distinguishes local test/build claims from independent proof and any future separately authorized deployment; preserves denied action boundaries, hosted data/schema limits, original-resource and broad-owner-credential pilot limits. No authority or production-readiness overclaim found.

limits: No hosted API/authentication/data retrieval, deploy, grant/settings change, live RLS check or owner session used.
Actual external workout persistence, deployed schema compatibility and host answer rendering remain unverified.
Exact counts and double reads add database work; production latency/size distribution was not measured.
Original OAuth request resource remains unattested; normal owner credential remains broader than the exposed read-only tool. These pre-existing pilot constraints are unchanged.
